messages:
From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.example.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.example.com>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.example.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.example.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intersectional band review playbook - draft & prep items

Team —

I put together a short draft of a playbook for the intersectional band review workshop we discussed last week. Goal is to have a consistent process for cross-team comparisons (Product ↔ Infra ↔ Platform) and a concrete handling path for edge cases and appeals. Key asks in the draft:

- Anchors: 3 scored examples per band with annotated evidence (positive/negative signals).
- Exception intake: canonical CSV with supporting evidence links and category tags (bias/role-mismatch/comp-doc error).
- Rater rotation: proposed schedule so the same raters aren’t repeatedly comparing the same individuals.
- Double-blind samples: small random sample to measure inter-rater drift.
- Timeline: final calibration session on Mon Aug 24, follow-ups by Fri Aug 28.

I attached the draft (calibration_playbook_draft_v1.pdf) and a small set of anchor examples (anchor_examples.zip) so you can see the format. Please review the anchors and the exception categories and tell me: what’s missing, what will create legal/compliance friction, and whether the proposed 1-hour workshop on Aug 24 10:00–11:00 PT works for your teams.

If we want external facilitation, I’ve included PeopleMatters as a potential partner — they can run a neutral scoring exercise and produce a short inter-rater reliability report.

Next steps I propose: everyone confirm by EOD today, curators upload anchors by Friday 8/21, legal/HR signoff on intake fields by Monday.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Manager, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.example.com>

Cc: irene_choi <irene@redwood.example.com>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intersectional band review playbook - draft & prep items

Diego —

Thanks for pulling this together; useful structure. A few quick notes:

- Intake fields: Legal asked that we minimize PII in the public exception log and instead link to a restricted HR packet. I attached a short exception_log_aug20.csv skeleton that uses redacted identifiers + secure Drive link.
- Evidence buckets: please add a separate column for "candidate role expectations" vs "performance evidence" so we can distinguish role-mismatch from performance issues.
- Workshop attendees: recommend limiting to one manager repr per team + two calibration leads to avoid scope bloat.

We should confirm PeopleMatters pricing before we commit — I’ll loop in Acme HR contact (they used PeopleMatters last year) to get a read on deliverables and SOW terms.

I can review anchors for Product by EOD Friday.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Talent Programs
From: jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.example.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.example.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.example.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intersectional band review playbook - draft & prep items

Quick add from my side:

- Strong +1 on double-blind scoring. We should randomize a set of 30 cross-team samples (10 from each org) and have raters score them without band labels — that gives us a baseline ICC.
- Suggestion: include at least 2 samples from IC -> Manager transition band to see upward mobility signals.
- For facilitation, PeopleMatters is good but can we get an internal trial first (30 min dry-run) to validate the scoring rubric? If PeopleMatters is > $Xk we should reserve external funds for an independent audit only.

I’ll prepare a short scoring rubric addendum and push to the Drive folder by EOD.

-Jordan
From: evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.example.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.example.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.example.com>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.example.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T16:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intersectional band review playbook - draft & prep items

Thanks all — workshop finished and produced a clear set of outcomes. Summary + immediate asks below.

Summary:
- We ran the double-blind exercise on 30 samples. Preliminary inter-rater ICC = 0.62 (moderate). PeopleMatters observed potential drift in the Manager band around leadership signals.
- Anchors: Product anchors accepted with minor edits; Infra anchors need stronger system-impact examples.
- Exceptions: 6 new exceptions submitted; 2 flagged for legal review (one PII pattern, one potential discrimination concern).

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Diego: update playbook with rubric addendum and include the double-blind protocol (ETA 8/26). Attachment: post-workshop-action-items.md
- Marissa: finalize exception intake CSV and coordinate with Legal for redaction requirements (ETA 8/27).
- Jordan: deliver revised anchors for Infra and the 30-sample scoring pack (ETA 8/25).
- Irene: conveyor to People Ops for follow-up communications & record the calibration minutes in the HR system (ETA 8/28).

Links: workshop recording + scoring spreadsheet in Drive (see related_links). I’ll open a Jira SUP ticket for the two legal escalations and link it in the log once created.

We should reconvene in two weeks for a quick check-in on whether the ICC has improved after the revised anchors and rubric.

—Evelyn Hart
Sr. People Partner, Calibration Lead
Redwood Inference
